apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Keys to connect external systems to the Arenile API, with limited permissions and optional expiry.
apiKeys.usage: External services send the key with every request in the header
apiKeys.emptyHint: Create one key per external system, with only the permissions it needs.
apiKeys.formHint: A key acts only on this establishment and only with the chosen permissions.
apiKeys.nameHint: To recognise it, for example the name of the system.
apiKeys.expiryHint: Optional: after this day the key stops working.
apiKeys.scopesHint: User management is never granted to keys.
apiKeys.revokeConfirm: Requests made with this key will be refused immediately. This cannot be undone.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Signed notifications to your systems when bookings, payments and configuration change, with a delivery log.
webhooks.formHint: Arenile sends a signed POST request to this address for every chosen event.
webhooks.urlHint: Must be https; http is allowed only to localhost for testing.
webhooks.eventsHint: Choose single events, a whole group or every event.
webhooks.activeHint: When paused, events are not sent (the test still works).
webhooks.deleteConfirm: The endpoint and its delivery log will be deleted.
webhooks.rotateHint: Generates a new signing secret. During the grace period deliveries are signed with both.
webhooks.graceHint: Time to update the secret in the receiving system.

graceOption.h0: None (the old one stops at once)

webhooks.rotatedDescription: Update the receiving system within the grace period.
webhooks.createdDescription: Here is the secret to verify the signature of deliveries.
webhooks.signatureHow: v1 is the HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the endpoint secret, of "<t>.<body>"; during a rotation two v1 values appear.
webhooks.emptyHint: Add your system's address to receive Arenile events.
webhooks.testNoResponse: No response from the receiving system
